title: Successive infinitesimal transition is a finite order thickening
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a scheme morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Put $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every $n\ge0$, the canonical map $j_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ induced by $A/I^{n+2}\to A/I^{n+1}$ is a finite order thickening [def-sbc-first-order-thickening] and a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism].

proof.text: The quotient factor map $A/I^{n+2}\to A/I^{n+1}$ is surjective and its kernel is the image of $I^{n+1}$. The square of this kernel is zero because $n+2\le 2(n+1)$.

proof.text: Apply the nested-ideal quotient base-change description with $J=I^{n+2}$ and $J^\prime=I^{n+1}$. Its unique transition is the displayed pullback.map (both projection identities agree). It is a closed immersion. On an affine open with ring $B$ the transition is the quotient $B/I^{n+2}B\to B/I^{n+1}B$, with kernel $I^{n+1}B/I^{n+2}B$. This kernel has square zero by the preceding inequality. Thus its defining ideal sheaf has square zero on an affine basis, hence globally, and it is a finite order thickening.

source.place: Tag 0GS2, lemma-finite-etale-on-proper-over-henselian-pair, complete Noetherian essential-surjectivity paragraph, before algebraization

proof.text: Every prime of each affine coordinate ring contains the square-zero kernel. The zero-locus description of the image of a closed immersion therefore makes the transition surjective. A surjective closed immersion is a universal homeomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem infinitesimal_transition_thickening
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (n : ℕ) :
    let j := (pullback.map f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))
        f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))) (𝟙 X)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
        (𝟙 _) (by simp)
        (by rw [Category.comp_id, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
              Ideal.Quotient.factor_comp_mk]))
    IsFiniteOrderThickening j ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism j
